sections.normalized_html:
Given a [MATH: 2 \times 2] matrix [MATH: [a|b; c|d]]

the inverse of [MATH: A] can be found using the following formula:

[MATH: A^{− 1}|= (1)/(det(A))[d|− b; − c|a].]

First, we compute the determinant: [MATH: \det(A) = 1 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot (-2) = 1]

Using the formula, then, the inverse is given by

[MATH: A^{− 1}|= (1)/(det(A))[d|− b; − c|a].; = (1)/(1)[1|− 0; − (− 2)|1]; = [1|0; 2|1].]

We can verify the result as follows:

[MATH: AA^{− 1}|= [1|0; − 2|1][1|0; 2|1]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓; A^{− 1}A|= [1|0; 2|1][1|0; − 2|1]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓]

Content:
Given a matrix [MATH: [a|b; c|d]]
we have been using the following formula to compute the inverse:
[MATH: [d|− b; − c|a]]

Content:
To check that this formula is correct for a general matrix [MATH: A], we need to verify that
[MATH: AA^{-1} = A^{-1}A = I_2.]

Content:
First, we compute [MATH: A^{-1}A\mathbin{:}]

Content:
[MATH: A^{− 1} ⋅ A|= (1)/(ad − bc)[d|− b; − c|a] ⋅ [a|b; c|d]; = (1)/(ad − bc)[ad − bc|0; 0|− bc + ad]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓]

Content:
Then, we compute [MATH: A A^{-1}\mathbin{:}]

Content:
[MATH: A ⋅ A^{− 1}|= [a|b; c|d] ⋅ (1)/(ad − bc)[d|− b; − c|a]; = (1)/(ad − bc)[a|b; c|d] ⋅ [d|− b; − c|a]; = (1)/(ad − bc)[ad − bc|0; 0|− bc + ad]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓]

Content:
So, we have verified that
[MATH: AA^{-1} = A^{-1}A = I_2,]
and we can be sure that the given formula is the correct formula for [MATH: A^{-1}.]

Item 2 — Example: Calculating the Inverse of a 2x2 Matrix

Example Prompt:
Calculate [MATH: A^{-1},] where
[MATH: [1|0; − 2|1]]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
Given a [MATH: 2 \times 2] matrix
[MATH: [a|b; c|d]]

the inverse of [MATH: A] can be found using the following formula:

[MATH: A^{− 1}|= (1)/(det(A))[d|− b; − c|a].]

First, we compute the determinant:
[MATH: \det(A) = 1 \cdot 1 - 0 \cdot (-2) = 1]

Using the formula, then, the inverse is given by

[MATH: A^{− 1}|= (1)/(det(A))[d|− b; − c|a].; = (1)/(1)[1|− 0; − (− 2)|1]; = [1|0; 2|1].]

We can verify the result as follows:

[MATH: AA^{− 1}|= [1|0; − 2|1][1|0; 2|1]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓; A^{− 1}A|= [1|0; 2|1][1|0; − 2|1]; = [1|0; 0|1]; = I_{2}✓]
